title: On accessibility of the core in mutidimensional spatial majority voting situations
abstract: arXiv:2609.10029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper we consider situations of (multidimensional) spatial majority voting. We analyze such situations having an even number (greater than or equal to 4) of voters and assume that each voter's preference over the set of policies is ``Euclidean": i.e., each voter has a most preferred ``ideal" policy and the voter's pay-offs from policies decrease as the (Euclidean) distance of the policies from the ideal policy goes up. We confine attention to voting situations for which the core has a single element belonging to the interior of the policy set. It is known that under conditions usual in this literature, this element of the core, generally, is not a Condorcet winner: i.e., there is at least one policy outside the core such that the core-policy cannot be reached from it by just one round of majority domination. translated_title: 论多维空间多数投票情形中核心的可及性
translated_abstract: 本文研究（多维）空间多数投票情形。我们分析投票人数量为偶数（大于等于4）的此类情形，并假设每位投票人对政策集合的偏好是“欧几里得式”的：即每位投票人都有一项最优偏好的“理想”政策，且投票人从某项政策中获得的收益随着该政策与理想政策之间（欧几里得）距离的增加而递减。我们将研究范围限定于核心仅含单一元素且该元素位于政策集内部的政策投票情形。已知在该文献的通常条件下，这一核心元素一般并非孔多塞赢家：也就是说，核心之外至少存在一项政策，使得核心政策无法经由它仅通过一轮多数支配而达到。然而，我们证明，在此类条件下，从任何现行政策出发，通过有限次数的多数支配序列……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明在多维空间多数投票中，即使核心政策一般不是孔多塞赢家（无法通过一轮多数支配到达），从任何现行政策出发，经过有限次数的多数支配序列仍然可以到达核心。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that in multidimensional spatial majority voting, although the core element is generally not a Condorcet winner (not reachable by a single round of majority domination), the core can still be accessed from any incumbent policy through a finite sequence of majority dominations.
